title: Answer: the fractal geometry is a timeless expression of the dynamical law

statements.text: The fractal geometry of the invariant set can be read as a timeless, algebraic expression of the dynamical law, and evolution in time is motion along its trajectories. The universe is quasi-cyclic, a sequence of aeons in the manner of Penrose's conformal cyclic cosmology.

sources.quote: The fractal geometry can be thought of as providing a ‘timeless’ algebraic expression for the dynamical law.
